Definition: apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of πείρω (to "pierce"); through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across:--beyond, farther (other) side, over.
BiblicalUsage: Peran means beyond, across, on the other side. John baptized in Bethabara beyond Jordan, and Jesus told His disciples to go over to the other side of the lake — and they launched forth.
TheologicalSignificance: I take it that faith always crosses to the other side: John baptized beyond Jordan, and Jesus sailed beyond the shore.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
